Corollary
[Obtaining singularity models] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0403, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0404 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-ricci-flow-compactness ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-no-local-collapsing 1. appD:D.47\group Singularity Models

Let a closed Ricci flow become singular at $T<\infty $, and let $(x_i,t_i)\to T$ satisfy $K_i=|\operatorname {Rm}(x_i,t_i)|\to \infty $ and \[ \sup _{\mathcal M\times [t_i-\beta K_i^{-1},t_i]} |\operatorname {Rm}|\leq CK_i. \] After passing to a subsequence, the pointed dilations \[ g_i(t)=K_i g(t_i+K_i^{-1}t) \] converge on $[-\beta ,0]$ to a complete bounded-curvature Ricci flow, possibly on a different noncompact manifold. The limit is $\kappa $-noncollapsed on all scales for a uniform $\kappa >0$.
